Rina (AE): New POC request from ClearPay. 4-week pilot, VPC-only, CMK, token-sensitive. They estimate 7k DAU, ~5 calls/user/day, ~90 tokens/request. They want a clear cost range and success criteria.
Sam (SE): Quick calc: 7k * 5 * 90 = 3,150,000 tokens/day -> ~94.5M tokens/month. For 4-week pilot ~88M tokens. Baseline traffic they expect: 120 RPS, occasional campaign bursts to 700 RPS for <5 mins.
Arjun (Infra): Throughput estimate: assume model yields ~3k tok/s on our mid-tier GPU. Baseline 120 RPS * 90 tok = 10,800 tok/s -> ~4 mid GPUs; burst 700 RPS -> 63k tok/s -> ~21 mid GPUs ephemeral. Recommend reserve 2 mid GPUs and use autoscale + hosted overflow for bursts to control cost.
Marta (Security): Confirming: no third-party logging, CMK with customer access, audit logs in their S3 for 90 days. Network peering required.
Sam (SE): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalent): mid GPU ~$10/hr. Plan: reserve 2 mid GPUs 12h/day + burst pool of up to 6 mid GPUs on-demand. For 4 weeks that is roughly $6k infra. Platform/token fees add $2-4k depending on negotiated rate. Total ~ $8-10k. With stricter latency SLO or full H100 reservation cost would go up ~2-3x.
Rina (AE): They want SLOs and pass/fail criteria in SOW so finance can approve. Draft success criteria?
Sam (SE): Proposed success criteria:
1) p95 < 600ms on 25% sampled production traffic during the staging week.
2) Error rate < 1% (end-to-end).
3) Quality: >= 90% on a 150-prompt eval set with 20 manual spot checks.
4) Cost cap for pilot <= $11k (infra + platform + token fees).
5) Security: VPC peering complete, CMK policies validated, no external log sinks.
Arjun (Infra): Runbook bullets: peering & KMS (2 business days), reserve infra + canary (3 business days), autoscale tuning & observability hooks (2 days). Load test command we'll run:
```
heyload --rps 120 --burst 700 --duration 10m --payload=clearpay_prompts.json
```
Sam (SE): I'll prepare the 150-prompt eval (mix intents, long-contexts, and privacy edge cases). Example eval item:
```
{"prompt":"Describe charge: txn 9988 $12.00 on 2026-03-18","expected_intent":"explain_charge"}
```
POC-Bot: allocation_request created: cp-poc-4490 status=pending_network
Rina (AE): Thanks — I'll send this proposal to the buyer and request the security questionnaire answers in 48 hours. Target kickoff 12 business days out assuming approvals. :thumbsup:
